$comment: Sound effects for STUFFED. `pnpm sfx` generates any missing file with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (needs ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY in .env.local); `pnpm sfx --force name` regenerates one. Files land in packages/client/public/sfx/<name>.mp3 and are committed.
style: cartoon toy sound effect, playful, clean, no music, no voice

cork_pop.prompt: a toy cork gun firing: a crisp hollow cork pop

dart_shot.prompt: a foam dart blaster firing one dart: soft plastic thwip with a little air puff

soaker_shot.prompt: a toy water gun firing a big burst: pressurized squirt and splatter

hit_stuffing.prompt: a punch landing on a big soft plush teddy bear: deep muffled pillowy thump with a soft fabric puff

hit_armor.prompt: plastic sewing buttons clattering and rattling from a hit

impact.prompt: a soft foam ball hitting a fluffy cushion: muffled pillowy thud

knockout.prompt: a plush toy popping open at the seams: a soft fabric rip, then a big fluffy whoomp of cotton stuffing bursting out, comedic

chest_rattle.prompt: a small padded toy chest lid being jiggled open: a few soft muffled cushioned taps building up, gentle and cute

chest_open.prompt: a padded toy box lid popping open with a soft fluffy poof and a gentle sparkly chime

pickup_weapon.prompt: grabbing a soft foam toy blaster: squishy grab and a soft fabric swish

pickup_item.prompt: squeezing a small plush toy: soft squishy squeeze with a tiny cute squeak

heal.prompt: quick stitching with needle and thread, then a soft twinkle

armor_up.prompt: several plastic buttons snapping into place, satisfying clicks

reload.prompt: toy blaster reload: plastic click clack

swap.prompt: pulling a soft toy out of a fabric pouch: quick cloth rustle and a soft pat

jump.prompt: a squishy plush toy hopping up: soft springy squeak-boing

land.prompt: a plush toy plopping onto a soft cushion: gentle fluffy flump

rinse_rising.prompt: soapy water starting to flood in: rushing water with lots of bubbles, a warning swell

soggy.prompt: a soaked plush toy squelching with bubbles

win.prompt: short cheerful toy victory fanfare with kazoo and xylophone

lose.prompt: short sad cartoon deflating slide whistle, comedic

click.prompt: pressing a soft felt button: muffled cushioned tap

band_twang.prompt: a stretched rubber band snapping and flying off a wooden ruler: sharp twang

band_stretch.prompt: a rubber band slowly being stretched tight: rising creaky squeak

marble_shot.prompt: a toy tube launching a glass marble: hollow plastic thunk

marble_bounce.prompt: a glass marble bouncing off wood: bright clink

marble_burst.prompt: a burst of glass marbles scattering everywhere with a soft cartoon pop and clatter

pillow_swing.prompt: a big fluffy pillow swung fast through the air: soft whoosh

pillow_bonk.prompt: a pillow bonking a plush toy: comedic soft thwump with a squeaky boing

glitter_throw.prompt: a small sparkly ball tossed through the air: light whoosh with a tiny jingle

glitter_burst.prompt: a glitter bomb bursting: magical sparkly poof with shimmering twinkles

bubble_blow.prompt: blowing a big soap bubble from a wand: wobbly bloop

bubble_pop.prompt: a big soap bubble popping: wet cartoon pop

juice_slurp.prompt: sipping a juice box through a straw: quick slurp then a happy gulp

ball_boing.prompt: a bouncy rubber ball launching someone forward: springy cartoon boing

cardboard_place.prompt: a cardboard panel unfolding and slapping down onto grass: papery thump

bag_rustle.prompt: a big soft bag of cotton stuffing being rustled and squeezed

train_toot.prompt: a small wooden toy train whistle: a cheerful short toot toot
